name: extension-auto-license-page
description: The auto-license-page extension applied to a book carrying every attribute it reads. Proves the extension's effect matches the canonical toolchain — without a passing comparison against reference output, a claim that the extension matches is an assertion rather than a fact, and the extension is not done. Two chapters are present so the generated page is demonstrably after all body content, which is the placement decision this extension had to make: the converter's only hook that is both after the body and before the back cover is the :back call to ink_cover_page. The theme sets both contributed keys away from their defaults so a regression that stopped reading either fails rather than passing silently.
